meta_description: EICR Northwest Ltd offers trusted electrical services across Manchester. NICEIC-registered, fast turnaround on EICRs, installations & fault finding. Call today.
hero_subhead: Worried about electrical safety or a failing inspection? We deliver fast, reliable EICR certificates and expert electrical work across Greater Manchester.
services_heading: Complete Electrical Services Across Greater Manchester
services_subhead: From landlord safety certificates to full rewires and fault diagnosis, we cover every electrical need for homes and businesses in Manchester.

services.title: EICR Certificates
services.desc: We carry out thorough Electrical Installation Condition Reports for landlords, homeowners, and businesses. Certificates issued promptly — fully compliant with the 18th Edition Wiring Regulations.

services.title: Full & Partial Rewires
services.desc: Outdated wiring is a fire risk. Our qualified electricians rewire properties of all sizes with minimal disruption, leaving your home safe, tidy, and fully certified.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Upgrading your fuse board to a modern RCD-protected consumer unit improves safety and brings your installation up to current regulations. We complete most upgrades in a single day.

services.title: Fault Finding & Repairs
services.desc: Tripping circuits, dead sockets, or flickering lights? We locate and fix electrical faults quickly using specialist test equipment, restoring power and peace of mind.

services.title: Lighting Installation
services.desc: From LED downlight upgrades to full lighting design and installation, we transform the look and efficiency of your home or commercial space with quality fittings and neat cabling.

services.title: Landlord & Commercial Electrical
services.desc: We support Manchester landlords and business owners with PAT testing, periodic inspections, and new circuit installations — keeping properties compliant and tenants safe.

about_pullquote: Every job we do has to be safe, compliant, and done properly — no shortcuts.
about_para_1: EICR Northwest Ltd is a Manchester-based electrical contractor headquartered in the city centre at Oxford Court, M2. Founded by experienced, NICEIC-registered electricians, the business was built specifically to meet the growing demand for reliable, properly certified electrical inspections and installations across Greater Manchester and the surrounding areas.
about_para_2: We've built a reputation for straightforward pricing, clean workmanship, and certificates that are issued on time — every time. Whether you're a landlord needing a compliant EICR before a tenancy, a homeowner planning a rewire, or a business requiring a periodic inspection, our team delivers the same high standard of care on every single job.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Customers Say About EICR Northwest

reviews.text: Booked an EICR for my rental property and the lads were on time, professional, and had the certificate to me the same day. Absolutely brilliant service — will be using them for all my properties going forward.
reviews.author: James T.

reviews.text: Had a full consumer unit upgrade done last month. The electrician arrived when he said he would, explained everything clearly, and left the place spotless. Competitive price and great quality work. Highly recommended.

reviews.text: Called EICR Northwest after another firm left a fault unresolved for weeks. They diagnosed and fixed the problem within a couple of hours. Honest, knowledgeable, and genuinely good at what they do.
